% Selection rule applied: simple - context > 0,01 (§10)
\begin{figure*}[t]
  \centering
  \includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{figures/fig_failure_cases.pdf}
  \caption{Failure cases. Top: for each stream, the mean ROC-AUC of the three context-free configurations (MLP, the KitNET-style control and the statistical layer) minus the mean of the eight windowed ones. The pre-specified criterion, fixed before looking at any result, flags a stream when this difference exceeds $+0.01$ (dashed line; the shaded band is the $\pm 0.01$ region); flagged streams are hatched and marked with an asterisk below: KNAD Active Wiretap, KNAD SSL Renegotiation, CSE-CIC-IDS2018. The hatched band behind each bar is that stream's own run-to-run noise reference, $\max(\sqrt{2}\,\mathrm{SD}_{\mathrm{pool}}, 0.01)$; the number of seeds and the number of configurations averaged in each family are printed under each bar. A flag whose difference falls inside its own noise band selects the stream for inspection and is not evidence of an effect: with two seeds per cell these family means carry no usable interval. Bottom: ROC-AUC of the three configurations examined in every failure case, together with the row-index baseline AUC$_t$ of each stream and the chance level; a value at or below AUC$_t$ is not evidence of detection. The subsequent per-attack-type and false-positive analyses are exploratory and counted as such.}
  \label{fig:failure-cases}
\end{figure*}
